These templates remove the blank-page setup work. Copy one, keep the parts that help, and delete the rest.

## Available templates

- [Project home page](./project-index-template/)
- [Project overview](./project-overview-template/)
- [Public article](./article-template/)
- [Paper note](./paper-note-template/)
- [General research note](./note-template/)
- [Resource note](./resource-note-template/)
- [Experiment log](./experiment-note-template/)

## How to use them

1. Duplicate the placeholder project folder under `src/content/docs/projects/<project-slug>/`.
2. Use a project template for the landing page.
3. Copy a note template when a paper, resource, or experiment needs its own page.

The templates are scaffolding, not published research.
